title: Balayage to biodiversity: Are Europe’s hairdressers the secret weapon in tackling climate change?
titleZh: 理发店，可能是拯救地球的地方
summary:
最近，科学家们开始将目光投向美发沙龙，因为他们意识到，在推动气候行动方面，理发师或许是一种长期被“忽视”的力量。理发师不仅能帮顾客打理新长出的发根、修剪恼人的分叉，更以善于交谈而闻名。无论是聊即将到来的假期、周末计划，还是听你倾诉工作的烦心事——不知不觉间，理发师往往扮演着知心人、咨询者和朋友的多重角色。巴斯大学气候变化与社会转型中心（CAST）联合英国另外三所高校开展的一项最新研究指出，正是这种特质使美发沙龙成为一个“信任枢纽”，一个可以用来推动公众探讨气候变化的理想空间。

来源：Euronews；作者：Liam Gilliver；原文发布时间：2026-03-08 20:00:00

paragraphs.contentEn: Scientists have taken to the salon after realising hairdressers may be an “under-recognised” weapon in fuelling climate action. Alongside their ability to fix your roots and get rid of those pesky dead ends, hairdressers are renowned for their conversation skills. Whether it’s chatting about your upcoming holiday, plans for the weekend, or even ranting about your work – hairdressers have somehow become an agony aunt, counsellor and friend rolled into one. New research from the University of Bath’s Centre for Climate Change and Social Transformation (CAST) - alongside a trio of other British universities – reveals that this is what makes hair salons ‘hubs of trust’ that could be used to encourage conversations around climate change.
paragraphs.contentZh: 最近，科学家们开始将目光投向美发沙龙，因为他们意识到，在推动气候行动方面，理发师或许是一种长期被“忽视”的力量。理发师不仅能帮顾客打理新长出的发根、修剪恼人的分叉，更以善于交谈而闻名。无论是聊即将到来的假期、周末计划，还是听你倾诉工作的烦心事——不知不觉间，理发师往往扮演着知心人、咨询者和朋友的多重角色。巴斯大学气候变化与社会转型中心（CAST）联合英国另外三所高校开展的一项最新研究指出，正是这种特质使美发沙龙成为一个“信任枢纽”，一个可以用来推动公众探讨气候变化的理想空间。

paragraphs.contentEn: The research team conducted in-depth interviews with 30 UK salon owners and directors about their climate and sustainability interactions. They then ran a nationwide intervention in 25 sustainable salons using ‘Mirror Talkers’, where eco-tips are placed on salon mirrors to prompt sustainable haircare conversations.
paragraphs.contentZh: 研究团队首先对英国30家美发沙龙的店主和负责人进行了深入访谈，了解他们就气候变化与可持续议题与顾客交流互动的情况。随后，研究人员在全英25家主打可持续理念的美发沙龙开展了一项干预实验，引入了名为“镜前话题贴”（Mirror Talkers）的方式，即在理发镜上张贴环保小贴士，以此触发顾客与理发师之间关于可持续美发护发的对话。

paragraphs.contentEn: “Most of us think a ‘green’ product is one with recyclable packaging, but the carbon footprint of shampoo is mostly in the hot water used,” says Denise Baden of the University of Southampton. “Simple messages such as ‘most of us use too much shampoo and shampoo too often’ can prompt conversations about how shampooing less and at lower temperatures saves time, money, energy, water and is better for your skin and hair.”
paragraphs.contentZh: 南安普顿大学的丹妮丝·巴登表示：“大多数人认为，所谓的‘绿色’产品就是使用可回收包装的产品，但实际上，洗发水的碳足迹主要来自洗头时消耗的热水。像‘我们大多数人用的洗发水太多、洗头也太频繁’这样的简单提示，就能引发关于如何减少洗头频率、调低水温的讨论，这样既节省时间和金钱，也能减少能源与水资源的消耗，对皮肤和头发同样更有益处。”

paragraphs.contentEn: The study, published in the journal Humanities & Social Sciences Communications, found that almost 73 per cent of salon clients said they were likely to change their haircare routine after conversations prompted by the Mirror Talkers. Some even reported switching to eco-friendly products, turning down their hot water, and changing habits at home.
paragraphs.contentZh: 这项研究发表于《人文与社会科学通讯》期刊，结果显示，在“镜前话题贴”引发的交流后，近73%的受访美发沙龙顾客表示，他们可能会改变自己的日常护发习惯。一些受访者还提到，自己已经开始付诸行动，例如改用更环保的洗护产品、调低洗发时的水温，并在家中调整个人习惯。

paragraphs.contentEn: Researchers say this demonstrates how hairdressers have an “untapped ability” to weave climate change into everyday conversations and actions. They are now urging policymakers to roll out tools like Mirror Talkers nationally, and recognise that salons are valuable spaces for climate engagement. “If we’re serious about building a public movement for climate action, then it’s time to invest in these unsung influencers because real change starts in everyday conversations,” says Dr Sam Hampton of CAST.
paragraphs.contentZh: 研究人员表示，这一结果表明，理发师拥有一种“尚未被充分发掘的能力”，能够将气候变化议题融入日常的交谈与行动中。研究团队目前正呼吁政策制定者在全英国范围内推广“镜前话题贴”等工具，并认识到美发沙龙是推动公众参与气候议题的重要场所。气候变化与社会转型中心的萨姆·汉普顿博士指出：“如果我们真的希望为气候行动凝聚广泛的公众力量，那么现在正是时候投入资源，支持这些默默无闻的影响者，因为真正的改变，往往始于日常的对话。”

paragraphs.contentEn: Matilda Collins, a senior director and stylist at Paul Edmonds London in the UK, tells Euronews Green that clients are becoming "more vocal" when it comes to the types of ingredients their hair products have. At the same time, the salon is becoming increasingly aware of its own environmental footprint and implementing energy-saving changes – including a heat exchange system to reduce the need for constant water heating.
paragraphs.contentZh: 英国伦敦保罗·埃德蒙兹沙龙的高级总监兼发型师玛蒂尔达·柯林斯在接受《欧洲新闻·绿色频道》采访时表示，在洗护产品成分方面，如今的顾客变得“更愿意表达自己的看法”。与此同时，这家沙龙也越来越注重自身的环境足迹，并已开始推行一系列节能措施——包括安装热交换系统，以减少持续加热用水的需求。

paragraphs.contentEn: Euronews Green introduced the 'Mirror talkers' initiative to Collins, who says it could garner positive outcomes if the experience "feels natural and captures the client's attention without it feeling too virtuous". She adds: "Ultimately, the relationship and trust that a stylist builds with the client is what will encourage a potential positive change in behaviour when we think about purchasing a specific brand. It could be a great education platform and prompt for the conversation, however."
paragraphs.contentZh: 《欧洲新闻·绿色频道》向柯林斯介绍了“镜前话题贴”这一倡议，柯林斯认为，如果这种方式“让人感觉自然，并能在不过于说教的情况下吸引顾客注意”，就可能带来积极的效果。她补充说：“归根结底，发型师与顾客之间建立的关系和信任，才是在顾客考虑购买某个品牌时，促使他们改变行为的关键因素。不过，这样的方式本身确实是一个很好的科普平台，并为展开相关对话提供契机。”
